name: Knights Table Food Bank and Meal Programs
description: Food bank and meal supports for people in Brampton and Peel dealing with hunger, poverty, or homelessness.
eligibility_notes: 211 Ontario lists individuals and families dealing with hunger, poverty, and homelessness in Peel; confirm current provider wording before live entry.
application_process: 211 Ontario lists new intakes Monday to Thursday between 10 AM and 2 PM on a first come, first served basis; provider confirmation is still required.
documents_required: 211 Ontario lists identification for all household members and proof of address.
hours_text: 211 Ontario lists pantry hours Monday to Friday 10 AM to 3:30 PM for registered users. Provider homepage address differs from 211 pantry address and must be resolved before live entry.

coverage.label: Brampton
coverage.notes: Brampton provider; exact pantry address requires human L1 resolution.
